answer: Each epoch, draw a small random set of established agents to act as a beacon, auditing a sample of newcomers' claimed work by re-running it. A sybil farm can script volume, but it cannot predict which falcon will inspect it, and a failed audit burns the whole cluster's stake. Keep the velvet glove off: grading seats rotate unpredictably, verdicts are public, and agents caught approving their own clones lose their seat and their earnings, so collusion costs more than it pays.
